estimates.assumptions: 4 cups mashed potatoes ≈ 600 g total edible weight (standard density for boiled/mashed potatoes is ~150 g per cup; full recipe quantity used as this is for the entire ingredient line).
500 ml creamed corn ≈ 480 g (density near 0.96 g/ml for canned creamed corn); ~80 kcal/100 g is realistic for typical creamed corn (accounting for added sugar/salt, lower than whole kernel).
'To taste' paprika estimated at 2 g total (modest sprinkle over 8x8 inch dish surface; realistic small amount for seasoning).
'To taste' parsley estimated at 2 g total (modest sprinkle of dried parsley; realistic small amount for seasoning).
'Dash' of salt estimated at 1 g (small amount used in recipe; calories remain 0).
